retrieval_template_description: Retrieve requirements, produced effects, and support around the current step.
cypher:
MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[:HAS_PREDICATE|HAS_ENTITY|HAS_CONSTRAINT|REQUIRES|PRODUCES|DEPENDS_ON|SUPPORTED_BY*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS rel
RETURN
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  type(rel) AS relation,
  rel.required_condition AS required_condition,
  rel.supporting_effect AS supporting_effect,
  labels(n) AS evidence_labels,
  n.display_label AS evidence_label,
  n.name AS evidence_name,
  n.args AS evidence_args,
  n.kind AS evidence_kind,
  n.status AS evidence_status,
  n.support_status AS support_status,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, evidence_label
LIMIT $limit

Shared procedural step list:
Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Shared procedural step list:
Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

Shared procedural step list:
Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[:HAS_PREDICATE|HAS_ENTITY|HAS_CONSTRAINT|REQUIRES|PRODUCES|DEPENDS_ON|SUPPORTED_BY*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS rel
RETURN
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  type(rel) AS relation,
  rel.required_condition AS required_condition,
  rel.supporting_effect AS supporting_effect,
  labels(n) AS evidence_labels,
  n.display_label AS evidence_label,
  n.name AS evidence_name,
  n.args AS evidence_args,
  n.kind AS evidence_kind,
  n.status AS evidence_status,
  n.support_status AS support_status,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, evidence_label
LIMIT $limit

Shared procedural step list:
Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

  n.kind AS evidence_kind,

  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, evidence_label
LIMIT $limit

Shared procedural step list:
Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.


Operator question:

response:

retrieval_template_description: Retrieve requirements, produced effects, and support around the current step.
cypher:
MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[:HAS_PREDICATE|HAS_ENTITY|HAS_CONSTRAINT|REQUIRES|PRODUCES|DEPENDS_ON|SUPPORTED_BY*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS rel
RETURN
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  type(rel) AS relation,
  rel.required_condition AS required_condition,
  rel.supporting_effect AS supporting_effect,
  labels(n) AS evidence_labels,
  n.display_label AS evidence_label,
  n.name AS evidence_name,
  n.args AS evidence_args,
  n.kind AS evidence_kind,
  n.status AS evidence_status,
  n.support_status AS support_status,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, evidence_label
LIMIT $limit

Shared procedural step list:
Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  $step_id AS requested_step_id,
  s IS NOT NULL AS current_step_found,
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.index AS step_index,
  s.action_description AS action_description,

  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS neighbor_labels,
  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,
  n.name AS neighbor_name,
  n.args AS neighbor_args,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, neighbor_label
LIMIT $limit

Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

retrieval_template_description: Retrieve the current step and direct graph evidence.
cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  $step_id AS requested_step_id,
  s IS NOT NULL AS current_step_found,
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.index AS step_index,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.action_name AS action_name,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS neighbor_labels,
  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,
  n.name AS neighbor_name,
  n.args AS neighbor_args,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, neighbor_label
LIMIT $limit

Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

retrieval_template_description: Retrieve the current step and direct graph evidence.
cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  $step_id AS requested_step_id,
  s IS NOT NULL AS current_step_found,
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.index AS step_index,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.action_name AS action_name,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS neighbor_labels,
  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,
  n.name AS neighbor_name,
  n.args AS neighbor_args,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, neighbor_label
LIMIT $limit

Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

retrieval_template_description: Retrieve the current step and direct graph evidence.
cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  $step_id AS requested_step_id,
  s IS NOT NULL AS current_step_found,
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.index AS step_index,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.action_name AS action_name,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS neighbor_labels,
  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,
  n.name AS neighbor_name,
  n.args AS neighbor_args,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, neighbor_label
LIMIT $limit

Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

retrieval_template_description: Retrieve the current step and direct graph evidence.
cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  $step_id AS requested_step_id,
  s IS NOT NULL AS current_step_found,
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.index AS step_index,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.action_name AS action_name,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS neighbor_labels,
  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,
  n.name AS neighbor_name,
  n.args AS neighbor_args,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, neighbor_label
LIMIT $limit

Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

retrieval_template_description: Retrieve the current step and direct graph evidence.
cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  $step_id AS requested_step_id,
  s IS NOT NULL AS current_step_found,
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.index AS step_index,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.action_name AS action_name,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS neighbor_labels,
  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,
  n.name AS neighbor_name,
  n.args AS neighbor_args,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, neighbor_label
LIMIT $limit

Shared procedural step list:
Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  $step_id AS requested_step_id,
  s IS NOT NULL AS current_step_found,
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.index AS step_index,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.action_name AS action_name,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS neighbor_labels,
  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,
  n.name AS neighbor_name,
  n.args AS neighbor_args,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance

prompt.system_prompt: You are an assistant helping a novice assembly operator perform a manufacturing task. Answer the operator's specific question directly, using only the information provided. Be concise, practical, and safety-aware. Do not use any knowledge beyond what is explicitly provided. If information is missing, uncertain, or conflicting, say so clearly rather than guessing. Write in plain language as if you were directly guiding the operator. Translate technical notation, predicate names, relation labels, graph terms, and internal system terminology into natural wording. Do not write predicate-like phrases such as "requires installed(...)", "produces installed(...)", "hasInstallTarget(...)", or relation labels such as "SUPPORTED_BY" or "DEPENDS_ON"; explain their meaning instead. You may mention step numbers, part names, tool names, and earlier actions when they help answer the operator's question or support the answer. If the question asks what happens next or what earlier action supports the current step, answer that using only the provided information. Do not expose internal labels unless they are necessary to identify a part, tool, or step. Keep the answer precise and directly useful. Do not add extra coaching, encouragement, or procedural advice unless it is supported by the provided information. End every response with the exact marker "(EOR)" on the final line.

OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN

  s IS NOT NULL AS current_step_found,
  s.step_id AS step_id,

  s.action_description AS action_description,

  s.status AS status,

  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS neighbor_labels,
  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,
  n.name AS neighbor_name,
  n.args AS neighbor_args,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, neighbor_label
LIMIT $limit

Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

retrieval_template_description: Retrieve the current step and direct graph evidence.
cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  $step_id AS requested_step_id,
  s IS NOT NULL AS current_step_found,
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.index AS step_index,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.action_name AS action_name,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS neighbor_labels,
  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,
  n.name AS neighbor_name,
  n.args AS neighbor_args,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, neighbor_label
LIMIT $limit

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

retrieval_template_description: Retrieve the current step and direct graph evidence.
cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  $step_id AS requested_step_id,
  s IS NOT NULL AS current_step_found,
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.index AS step_index,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.action_name AS action_name,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS neighbor_labels,
  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,
  n.name AS neighbor_name,
  n.args AS neighbor_args,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, neighbor_label
LIMIT $limit

Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

retrieval_template_description: Retrieve the current step and direct graph evidence.
cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  $step_id AS requested_step_id,
  s IS NOT NULL AS current_step_found,
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.index AS step_index,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.action_name AS action_name,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS neighbor_labels,
  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,
  n.name AS neighbor_name,
  n.args AS neighbor_args,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, neighbor_label
LIMIT $limit

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

retrieval_template_description: Retrieve the current step and direct graph evidence.
cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  $step_id AS requested_step_id,
  s IS NOT NULL AS current_step_found,
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.index AS step_index,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.action_name AS action_name,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS neighbor_labels,
  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,
  n.name AS neighbor_name,
  n.args AS neighbor_args,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, neighbor_label
LIMIT $limit

Shared procedural step list:
Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.


Operator question:
If an O-ring was placed in the wrong hole and then corrected, where would I see that in the graph?

response:
You would see that in the graph as an observed effect where the O-ring is aligned with the rod holes.

expected_answer_elements: state that the current graph has no wrong-hole or correction event
state that only the successful inserted/aligned effects are represented
avoid claiming error recovery evidence

retrieval_template_description: Retrieve the current step and direct graph evidence.
cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  $step_id AS requested_step_id,
  s IS NOT NULL AS current_step_found,
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.index AS step_index,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.action_name AS action_name,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS neighbor_labels,
  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,
  n.name AS neighbor_name,
  n.args AS neighbor_args,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, neighbor_label
LIMIT $limit

Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,

  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, neighbor_label

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Shared procedural step list:
Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.


Operator question:
Why is the final tightening step uncertain even though the threadlocker and power screwdriver are present?

response:
The final tightening step is uncertain because the following required conditions have not been met:

*   The screws are not aligned with the O-rings.
*   The screws are not aligned with the rod holes.

While the use of a power screwdriver and the application of threadlocker to the screws are supported, these alignment issues must be addressed.

(EOR)

MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[:HAS_PREDICATE|HAS_CONSTRAINT|REQUIRES|PRODUCES|DERIVED_FROM|SUPPORTED_BY*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  s.warning_count AS warning_count,
  s.has_rule_coverage AS has_rule_coverage,
  s.has_expected_effect AS has_expected_effect,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS evidence_labels,
  n.display_label AS evidence_label,
  n.name AS evidence_name,
  n.args AS evidence_args,
  n.confidence AS evidence_confidence,
  n.status AS evidence_status,
  n.support_status AS support_status,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, evidence_label
LIMIT $limit

Shared procedural step list:
Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

cypher:
MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[:HAS_PREDICATE|HAS_CONSTRAINT|REQUIRES|PRODUCES|DERIVED_FROM|SUPPORTED_BY*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  s.warning_count AS warning_count,
  s.has_rule_coverage AS has_rule_coverage,
  s.has_expected_effect AS has_expected_effect,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS evidence_labels,
  n.display_label AS evidence_label,
  n.name AS evidence_name,
  n.args AS evidence_args,
  n.confidence AS evidence_confidence,
  n.status AS evidence_status,
  n.support_status AS support_status,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, evidence_label
LIMIT $limit

Shared procedural step list:
Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

retrieval_template_description: Retrieve confidence, status, warnings, and source/provenance evidence.
cypher:
MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[:HAS_PREDICATE|HAS_CONSTRAINT|REQUIRES|PRODUCES|DERIVED_FROM|SUPPORTED_BY*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  s.warning_count AS warning_count,
  s.has_rule_coverage AS has_rule_coverage,
  s.has_expected_effect AS has_expected_effect,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS evidence_labels,
  n.display_label AS evidence_label,
  n.name AS evidence_name,
  n.args AS evidence_args,
  n.confidence AS evidence_confidence,
  n.status AS evidence_status,
  n.support_status AS support_status,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, evidence_label
LIMIT $limit

Shared procedural step list:
Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

This step is valid because the sleeves are already on the metal rod, which is a required condition.

retrieval_template_description: Retrieve confidence, status, warnings, and source/provenance evidence.
cypher:
MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[:HAS_PREDICATE|HAS_CONSTRAINT|REQUIRES|PRODUCES|DERIVED_FROM|SUPPORTED_BY*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  s.warning_count AS warning_count,
  s.has_rule_coverage AS has_rule_coverage,
  s.has_expected_effect AS has_expected_effect,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS evidence_labels,
  n.display_label AS evidence_label,
  n.name AS evidence_name,
  n.args AS evidence_args,
  n.confidence AS evidence_confidence,
  n.status AS evidence_status,
  n.support_status AS support_status,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, evidence_label
LIMIT $limit

OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[:HAS_PREDICATE|HAS_CONSTRAINT|REQUIRES|PRODUCES|DERIVED_FROM|SUPPORTED_BY*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  s.warning_count AS warning_count,
  s.has_rule_coverage AS has_rule_coverage,
  s.has_expected_effect AS has_expected_effect,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS evidence_labels,
  n.display_label AS evidence_label,
  n.name AS evidence_name,
  n.args AS evidence_args,
  n.confidence AS evidence_confidence,
  n.status AS evidence_status,
  n.support_status AS support_status,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, evidence_label
LIMIT $limit

Shared procedural step list:
Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

Some requirements come from the domain model. How can I tell whether they were actually observed?

response:
To determine if a requirement was actually observed, you can look at the "support status" of the evidence. 

In the provided data, requirements (constraints) are labeled as either "supported" or "observed." For example, the requirement that the sleeve must be adjusted over the O-ring is listed as "supported," whereas the effect of the screws being partially inserted into the rod holes is listed as "observed."

retrieval_template_description: Retrieve the current step and direct graph evidence.
cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  $step_id AS requested_step_id,
  s IS NOT NULL AS current_step_found,
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.index AS step_index,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.action_name AS action_name,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS neighbor_labels,
  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,
  n.name AS neighbor_name,
  n.args AS neighbor_args,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance

Shared procedural step list:
Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

retrieval_template_description: Retrieve the current step and direct graph evidence.
cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  $step_id AS requested_step_id,
  s IS NOT NULL AS current_step_found,
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.index AS step_index,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.action_name AS action_name,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS neighbor_labels,
  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,
  n.name AS neighbor_name,
  n.args AS neighbor_args,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, neighbor_label
LIMIT $limit

Shared procedural step list:
Pilot rod assembly procedure:

Step 1 [0-15s]: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

Step 2 [15-89s]: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod. The copper sleeve should face to the right. The procedure specifies six copper sleeves and five long sleeves, starting and finishing with copper sleeves.

Step 3 [89-196s]: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

Step 4 [196-376s]: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

Step 5 [376-429s]: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

Step 6 [429-531s]: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves. The screws should go all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that they stick out.

Step 7 [531-566s]: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper. The copper part should not be polished.

Step 8 [566-642s]: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves while avoiding the copper sleeves.

cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  $step_id AS requested_step_id,
  s IS NOT NULL AS current_step_found,
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.index AS step_index,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.action_name AS action_name,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS neighbor_labels,
  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,
  n.name AS neighbor_name,
  n.args AS neighbor_args,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, neighbor_label
LIMIT $limit

retrieval_template_description: Retrieve the current step and direct graph evidence.
cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Step {graph_name: $graph_name})
WHERE s.step_id = $step_id
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (s)-[*0..2]-(n)
WHERE length(path) > 0
  AND all(intermediate IN nodes(path)[1..-1]
          WHERE intermediate:Predicate OR intermediate:Constraint)
WITH s, n, path, last(relationships(path)) AS r
RETURN
  $step_id AS requested_step_id,
  s IS NOT NULL AS current_step_found,
  s.step_id AS step_id,
  s.index AS step_index,
  s.action_description AS action_description,
  s.action_name AS action_name,
  s.object_labels AS object_labels,
  s.status AS status,
  s.confidence AS confidence,
  type(r) AS relation,
  labels(n) AS neighbor_labels,
  n.display_label AS neighbor_label,
  n.name AS neighbor_name,
  n.args AS neighbor_args,
  length(path) AS evidence_distance
ORDER BY evidence_distance, relation, neighbor_label
LIMIT $limit
